fields.raw_value: The Magic Faraway Tree is a residential cum commercial project located on Kanakapura Main road and is just 200 meters from the Nice Corridor and literally a skywalk away from the upcoming Metro Station. The Project comprises of 4 Residential towers and a commercial block along with amenities. First phase of the project is located on approx 7000sqm of land with one tower comprising of 74 residential units is completed with occupancy certificate obtained. Ongoing phase of the project is located on 8149 sqm of land and comprises of 2 towers with total of 240 residential units.
